title: A sound only some people can hear

lines.text: In one small town, some people hear a low hum that nobody can find.
Taos, New Mexico. Residents began reporting it in the early 1990s.
A study found that at least 2% of residents could hear it.
Each person heard it at a slightly different pitch, between 32 and 80 hertz. Like a distant engine.
Microphones and investigators never found a clear source.
Theories range from military radio signals to sounds produced inside the ear itself.
A similar hum in Windsor, Ontario, stopped in 2020, when a nearby steel plant shut down.
But in Taos, nobody has ever proven where it comes from.

sources.claim: Taos Hum: early-1990s study found at least 2% of residents heard it, at 32–80 Hz; explanations include military VLF radio and otoacoustic emissions
Windsor, Ontario hum stopped after the U.S. Steel plant on Zug Island ceased operations in April 2020
